summary: Frontend-only testing of Module 1 wizard (Entrevue guidée) on dossier 2a62630c-ef53-4938-80d9-9879858ae5fc. All specified scenarios pass: entrevue mode by default, progress banner, step title, Prev disabled at step 1, Next navigation with title/progress change, Prev returns to step 1, value entered in a text field persists across navigation, mode toggle (form vs entrevue) works, regression buttons/social-urls present in form mode, review step reached after N=12 clicks with 12 review rows and per-section Modifier buttons, Modifier returns to correct section, Terminer et enregistrer triggers 'Module 1 enregistré' toast, and after full reload the entrevue mode is default and the previously entered value is persisted.

issues: Auto-save fires on every 'Suivant' click producing multiple 'Module 1 enregistré' toasts stacked (observed 4). Consider silent auto-save on Suivant and only toast on explicit 'Terminer et enregistrer' / 'Enregistrer'.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Silence toast during auto-save on 'Suivant'; keep toast only on manual Enregistrer / Terminer et enregistrer to avoid toast spam.
critical_code_review_comments: Module1Form.jsx: save() is invoked on every 'Suivant' click and shows a success toast each time — leads to toast pile-up during wizard flow. Add a silent flag or debounce.
sectionCompletion divides by keys.length without guarding against empty sections (fine today but fragile if a section has 0 fields).
wizSection uses sections[Math.min(step, totalSteps-1)] but Card renders wizSection.fields directly — guard for empty sections array.
seed_data_creation: None (only entered TEST_WIZ_<ts> string in Section 1 first text field; persisted correctly).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Module 1 wizard fully functional. Login redirects to /dashboard (not /dossiers) — use waits instead of wait_for_url('**/dossiers**'). N=12 sections for this dossier (38 employés < 100 so no annexe I; 2 établissements > 1 so annexe II likely included). Review rows use data-testid m1-review-<sid>; Modifier buttons use m1-review-edit-<sid>. Auto-save-on-Next produces stacked toasts — cosmetic.
